title: Count Subsets With Even XOR
statement: Given a list of distinct non-negative integers nums (with 0 <= len(nums) <= 20), consider every possible subset of nums, including the empty subset (there are 2^len(nums) subsets total). Define the XOR of the empty subset to be 0. Return the number of subsets whose elements XOR together to an even value.
hints: There are 2^n subsets; think about representing each subset as an n-bit bitmask from 0 to 2^n - 1.
For a bitmask, bit j being set means nums[j] is included in that subset; you can compute each subset's XOR by scanning the set bits of the mask.
Loop mask from 0 to (1 << n) - 1, use mask & 1 and mask >>= 1 (or (mask >> j) & 1) to find included elements, XOR them together, and count masks whose XOR is even.
